'''Resoria''' was one of three smallish continents that were located in the southern hemisphere of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corulag/Legends|Corulag]], all of which had the same cycle of seasons. Underdeveloped areas of the continent were covered with dense [[Forest/Legends|forests]] of [[Corulag bamboo]], which was nearly impassable except on [[Limb/Legends|foot]] or in specialized bulldozer craft. [[Crullov City]], a mostly abandoned industrial [[City/Legends|city]] which was home to Corulag's limited criminal underworld, was located on Resoria's eastern seaboard.<ref name="CatCW" />

==Behind the scenes==
Resoria was mentioned in the [[2003]] ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'' sourcebook ''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]'', published by [[Wizards of the Coast]].<ref name="CatCW" />
